import copy,json; from work import evaluate

def chk(name,got,want):
 assert got==want,(name,got,want)
base_req={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2,'extra':'x'}}
pol={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':False}
# independent boundaries
chk('missing',evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}},[],pol),{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']})
chk('none',evaluate(base_req,[],pol),{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
ev=[{'source':'z','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':{'y':2,'x':1}},{'source':'a','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':{'x':1,'y':2}}]
chk('canonical agreement',evaluate(base_req,ev,pol),{'status':'supported','value':{'y':2,'x':1},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]})
chk('conflict',evaluate(base_req,ev+[{'source':'m','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':3}],pol),{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','m','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
chk('false',evaluate(base_req,[{'source':'s','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':False}],pol),{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['s'],'unknowns':[]})
chk('verified',evaluate(base_req,[{'source':'u','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':1}],dict(pol,require_verified=True)),{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
sev=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':1},{'source':'new','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':2,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'bad','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':9,'b':2},'value':9,'supersedes':['new']}]
chk('eligible supersession',evaluate(base_req,sev,pol),{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
r,e,p=copy.deepcopy(base_req),copy.deepcopy(sev),copy.deepcopy(pol); snapshots=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); evaluate(r,e,p); assert (r,e,p)==snapshots,'mutation'
print('boundary checks passed')
